retarget.method: Original mesh proportions preserved by a single uniform transform; independent source-length display skeleton follows original AMB/POS rotations; display weapon sockets follow the new hands.
retarget.fingerArticulation: Thumb and index chains of the native rig drive the source finger groups; other fingers fold into those two chains.

provenance.credit: 凝光「纱中幽兰」可编辑模型；原模型版权归 miHoYo，本包未附署名或配布说明文件。
provenance.license: No readme, credit or licence file was shipped with this pack. Treated as a private local conversion; not redistributed or published.
provenance.skinRepair: The source rig binds both long side drapes (新規) 100% to 頭 and the skirt (裙) partly to 小指先/腕; those materials are rebound along the body chain at build time. Geometry, materials and UVs are untouched.
limits: Original source proportions preserved; action retarget remains approximate.
Source is a .blend scene, not a PMX, so PMX-specific statistics are not applicable.
Co-planar colour layers 肌 (duplicate of 体2) and 肌2 (inside 体) are skipped.
Skirt and the long side drapes follow a blend along the pelvis/spine/thigh chain; there is still no cloth solver, so deep leg poses can intersect.
No expression morphs; sphere/toon maps are not reproduced.
Hair (髪 and the unnamed back locks) uses a Web spring rig derived from the built surface; hairpins and earrings stay rigid.

The hand keeps the authored open pose: the source knuckle weights stretch badly under large rotations (994 hand edges over 2x, worst 31x) and the model ships no grip morph, so a real grip needs extra finger bones.
provenance.drapeMorph: The author's 「袖带垂落 · 站姿」 shape key is baked into the surface so the side drapes hang for a standing pose instead of staying in the flying shape.
